cases.title: Registry identity
cases.assertion: A3-016 resolves as REMEDIATION / ON_DEMAND_TRACK with canonical A3-016.

cases.title: Content status
cases.assertion: Installed content remains REVIEW and is not exposed to ordinary paid users.

cases.title: Product grant
cases.assertion: Installation stops with a blocker when MLMA_FULL does not exist.

cases.title: Graph snapshot
cases.assertion: Actual A3-016 connectionIndex exactly matches the bundled v3 snapshot.

cases.title: Graph immutability
cases.assertion: Package install does not mutate 253 effective connections or neighboring pages.

cases.title: Incoming A2-008
cases.assertion: RR2-009 can assign A3-016 only for NEXT_NEEDS_REASON.

cases.title: Incoming A3-002
cases.assertion: RR2-015 can assign A3-016 only for MESSAGE_NOT_SENT_NO_REASON.

cases.title: Locked incoming directions
cases.assertion: A3-013, A3-015 and A6-027 remain locked without structured incoming rules.

cases.title: Embedded A6-027
cases.assertion: A6-027 is rendered only as an optional component inside A3-016, not as a new page.

cases.title: Reason found gate
cases.assertion: REASON_FOUND requires every manual truth, relevance, transparency, timing and boundary check to be true.

cases.title: Reason found route
cases.assertion: REASON_FOUND matches RR2-012 and targets A3-002.

cases.title: No reason route
cases.assertion: NO_REASON matches RR2-013 and returns WAIT_UNTIL without a track URL.

cases.title: No fake reason
cases.assertion: The system and AI refuse to invent an event or reason to avoid WAIT.

cases.title: Boundary terminal
cases.assertion: CONTACT_STOPPED matches RR3-A3-016-STOP and returns DONE.

cases.title: Boundary priority
cases.assertion: Explicit refusal or do-not-contact overrides REASON_FOUND and all selling branches.

cases.title: Locked outgoing A4-001
cases.assertion: TR-099 remains a hidden LOCKED_NEXT_ACTION_SLOT.

cases.title: Locked outgoing A3-017
cases.assertion: TR-100 remains a hidden LOCKED_NEXT_ACTION_SLOT.

cases.title: No field action here
cases.assertion: A3-016 does not send a message; it hands a local reason card to A3-002.

cases.title: Reason card local
cases.assertion: Fact text, purpose text and opener draft remain client-only.

cases.title: Server minimality
cases.assertion: Only structured allowlisted route facts reach persistence.

cases.title: PII rejection
cases.assertion: Names, phones, emails, handles, profile URLs and exact quotes are stripped before server/log/analytics.

cases.title: No wallet scoring
cases.assertion: The flow never evaluates purchasing power, profitability or value of the person.

cases.title: No health inference
cases.assertion: The flow never infers a health need or diagnosis from public or private context.

cases.title: Vulnerability stop
cases.assertion: Illness, grief, job loss, debt or acute distress cannot be used as a contact lever.

cases.title: Small-talk inversion
cases.assertion: The track does not prescribe fake small talk as a route into presentation.

cases.title: Compliment optional
cases.assertion: A6-027 can be skipped and never blocks completion.

cases.title: Compliment integrity
cases.assertion: A compliment/observation must be specific and sincere and cannot demand reciprocity.

cases.title: AI optional
cases.assertion: The deterministic manual track completes with AI disabled.

cases.title: AI default off
cases.assertion: AI_REASON_CRITIC_ENABLED defaults to false and is not enabled in production by install.

cases.title: Structured AI review
cases.assertion: Default AI review sends only structured codes and no free text.

cases.title: Sanitized AI consent
cases.assertion: Sanitized text review requires explicit consent and a user preview.

cases.title: AI transient data
cases.assertion: Sanitized text is not persisted, logged, traced, analyzed or used for training.

cases.title: AI cannot certify
cases.assertion: AI advisory output cannot set real_reason=true or execute a RouteRule.

cases.title: AI no invention
cases.assertion: AI returns NO_REASON_RECOMMENDED instead of fabricating facts.

cases.title: AI risk flags
cases.assertion: AI flags hidden intent, fake relevance, fake urgency, flattery, boundary bypass, vulnerability and unsupported claims.

cases.title: AI output limit
cases.assertion: AI asks at most three questions and returns at most two placeholder skeletons.

cases.title: Public metadata
cases.assertion: Public endpoint exposes only title, situation, result and route preview.

cases.title: Sandbox isolation
cases.assertion: PUBLIC_DEMO creates no instance, outcome, decision, AI request or entitlement.

cases.title: Search recommendation only
cases.assertion: Entry dataset can rank metadata but cannot create a live instance without the platform entry policy.

cases.title: Paid navigation off
cases.assertion: With PAID_TRACK_NAVIGATION_ENABLED=false, A3-002 destination remains locked with null URL.

cases.title: Draft rule clamp
cases.assertion: PILOT_DRAFT_TO_TEST rules do not execute in production mode.

cases.title: Analytics allowlist
cases.assertion: Analytics contains only coarse structured fields and never AI prompt text.

cases.title: Route explanation
cases.assertion: The user sees why the route is message, wait or done without exposing internal scoring.

cases.title: Rybkin adaptation
cases.assertion: Content preserves contact/readiness/shared frame and rejects behavior-control and mass-compliment mechanics.

cases.title: Second-book method
cases.assertion: Track uses reproducible structure, short practice and feedback rather than a lecture or memorized script.

cases.title: Schema validation
cases.assertion: package.json conforms to track-package.schema.json v1.

cases.title: Existing tests
cases.assertion: All existing project tests and typecheck remain green.

cases.title: No production side effects
cases.assertion: No deploy, production migration, payment, paid navigation or registration activation occurs.
